topic: Admission Leads Page: Actions (Follow-up, Visit, Notes, WhatsApp, Timeline)
summary: The Admission Leads page provides various direct actions for counselors to manage student interactions, including adding follow-ups, recording campus visits, making calls (with IVR), adding notes, reviewing student timelines, and initiating WhatsApp conversations.
steps: To add a follow-up: Click 'Add Follow-up' and enter the required details.
To record a campus visit: Click 'Add Visit', specify the visit date, and add any relevant notes.
To make a call: Click 'Make Calls'. (Requires IVR integration).
To add a note: Click 'Add Note' to record specific information or discussions with the student.
To check the student's timeline: Click 'Timeline' to view all historical activities, such as application creation, emails sent, and counselor interactions.
To open WhatsApp: Click 'Open WhatsApp' next to the student's name. This will automatically open WhatsApp Web with the student's number pre-filled, allowing direct communication.
important_notes: The 'Make Calls' feature requires integration with an IVR (Interactive Voice Response) system to function correctly.
The 'Open WhatsApp' feature automatically populates the student's phone number, streamlining communication.
